REFOSS.NAME: Refoss energy monitor
REFOSS.DESCRIPTION: Refoss EM16P / EM06P energy monitors through the local API (LAN)

HOST.NAME: Device address
HOST.DESCRIPTION: IP address or host name of the energy monitor, e.g. 192.168.1.60 (http is used). Give the device a fixed address in the router

PASSWORD.NAME: Password
PASSWORD.DESCRIPTION: Only when authentication is switched on in the Refoss app or web UI (user admin). Empty = no authentication

POLL.NAME: Polling interval [s]
POLL.DESCRIPTION: How often all channels are read (one request per poll)

SCAN.NAME: Search channels
SCAN.DESCRIPTION: Lists the channels of the device that are not configured yet, named after the names set in the Refoss app

CONNECTED.NAME: Connected
CONNECTED.DESCRIPTION: The last poll reached the device

CHANNEL.NAME: Channel
CHANNEL.DESCRIPTION: One current transformer (CT) of the energy monitor

ID.NAME: Channel number
ID.DESCRIPTION: EM16P: A1–A6 = 1–6 (black), B1–B6 = 7–12 (red), C1–C6 = 13–18 (blue). Merged channels use the id the device reports

VOLTAGE.NAME: Voltage [V]
VOLTAGE.DESCRIPTION: Voltage of the phase the channel is assigned to

DAY_ENERGY.NAME: Energy today [kWh]
DAY_ENERGY.DESCRIPTION: Consumption today, restarts at 0 every day. Link it to a meter logic for a running total

WEEK_ENERGY.NAME: Energy this week [kWh]
WEEK_ENERGY.DESCRIPTION: Consumption this week, restarts at 0 every week

MONTH_ENERGY.NAME: Energy this month [kWh]
MONTH_ENERGY.DESCRIPTION: Consumption this month, restarts at 0 every month. Link it to a meter logic for a running total
